steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with one invited vendor who has bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the RFQ scenario.
Keep counter offers visible on RFQs as required by the case configuration.
Use the required buyer bid-rejection setting for the live bidding state.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case configuration.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case configuration.
Click the participation percentage control named in the case.
Verify that the Participation Summary window opens.
Verify the invited-vendor count in the summary.
Verify the seen-vendor count in the summary.
Verify the bid-placed count in the summary.
Verify that no invited vendor is shown as not having placed a bid.
Verify the unregistered POC bid count.
Verify that the Notify button is available in the opened summary without pressing it.
